Priya K: hi all! first week here 👋 quick Q about Notion docs — I can see 'Company Home' and some team pages but I'm not sure where the canonical onboarding templates live or how to contribute small edits. anyone point me to the exact path and the preferred edit process?
Docs Bot: Welcome, Priya! Canonical templates are in Company Home / Docs / Templates. Onboarding-specific ones are at Company Home / Docs / Templates / New Hires. If you want to edit, join the docs-editors group via the SSO form: https://go.redwood.com/notion-access — choose "Edit: Docs" and include the team name.
Evan L: to add detail — templates you'll commonly use: 'New Hire Checklist (2025)', '1:1 Template', 'Tech Spec Minimal', and 'RFC Template'. For small edits (typo or clarifying sentence) feel free to duplicate the page, edit in your personal workspace, then paste the change back and add the "docs-edit" tag and ping @Ruth Gomez for a quick review.
Priya K: what counts as a "small" edit vs. something needing a review?
Ruth Gomez: small = copy fixes, formatting, links. Anything that changes process, ownership, or steps in an onboarding/ops doc = major. For major edits, create a short changelog entry on the page (top-right properties: add 'changelog' property) and schedule a quick review in the #devex channel or DM me.
Evan L: if you plan to keep the page in a team space (not personal workspace), ask for group access to that team space on the form. Example: for engineering onboarding, request access to 'Team Spaces / Eng / Onboarding'.
Priya K: is there a template for updating the docs' metadata (owners, last-reviewed date)?
Ruth Gomez: yes — we use the Doc Metadata template inside Templates. Fields to update: Owners, Last reviewed, Review cadence (90/180 days), and Tags (docs-edit, deprecated if removing).
Docs Bot: FYI — we also sync certain Notion pages to the docs static site. If you change a synced page, open a docs-contrib ticket so the web publish pipeline picks it up: https://go.redwood.com/docs-contrib. Add a brief summary and the page link.
Priya K: do I need GitHub access to submit changes to the public docs site?
Evan L: yes, to push to the mkdocs repo you need the 'docs-contrib' GitHub team. Submit a quick request via the access form or ask your manager to add you. For just Notion edits, GitHub is not required.
Ruth Gomez: quick how-to if you want to use a template: 1) open template page > 2) click ••• > 3) Duplicate > 4) Move to Team Space or your workspace > 5) Rename and update metadata. If you hit a permission error on move, mention @docs-admin.
Priya K: great — followed the links, duplicated the onboarding checklist, and updated the Owners field. One last thing: where are historical versions / changelog for onboarding?
Ruth Gomez: we keep changelog entries on each page in the page properties, plus a central changelog at Company Home / Docs / Changelog. For incidents or runbook changes, also update the Ops changelog.
Priya K: perfect, thanks everyone! saved the template to Eng space and opened a docs-contrib ticket for syncing. :tada:
